strategy.title: No plan: the only held market cannot carry $12,000
strategy.why: The decal-pack opening sells to a counted, whole market of 30 operators who each buy once a year, at an evidenced $250. Every buyer buying at that price brings $7,500, and the measured 40% conversion (12 of 30) brings about $3,000; both are below $12,000 within 60 days.

alternatives.title: Sell decal packs to the 30-operator register
alternatives.why: Economics, fulfilment, demand and settlement are all established, but the counted market caps revenue at $7,500 ($3,000 at measured conversion) — it is the plan to run if the target is lowered.

sources.claim: 30 operators on the county register, each renewing once a year

noPlan.decisiveGap: Market volume: the 30-operator register, buying once a year at $250, holds at most $7,500 of purchases in the window — $4,500 short of $12,000 even with every buyer agreeing.
noPlan.resolution: Lower the target to what the counted market supports ($3,000 at the measured 40% conversion, $7,500 ceiling), or have Brain research additional buyer populations (other counties' charter registers) for the same pack and re-plan once they are counted.

constraints.suggestion: Lower the target to $7,500 at most (every counted buyer at $250); $3,000 is what the measured 12-of-30 conversion supports.

review.reasons: NO_PLAN is right and the constraint is arithmetic on established figures: the card's EVIDENCE buyerVolume counts the whole market at 30 operators buying once a year, so at the evidenced $250 price the 60-day window holds at most 30 x $250 = $7,500 < $12,000 (48 deals needed, 30 exist). Every other link is established (conversion measured on this offer, $4 cost, 3-day settlement, Brain-proved spreadsheet fulfilment). Brain's MARKET_VOLUME judgement agrees. The TARGET constraint and resolution (lower to <= $7,500, ~$3,000 at measured 12/30 conversion, or count other counties' registers) follow from the figures.
findings: Minor: if the 12 measured acceptances came from the same 30-operator register, those operators have already bought this year and the remaining in-window market is below $7,500; this only strengthens the no-plan and should be stated when the target is reset.
